use_case: Pipeline leak-detection anomaly model: scores pressure, flow, temperature, and valve data by segment and raises advisory alerts for possible leaks or ruptures
vendor_or_model: In-house gradient-boosted anomaly model with mass-balance features; trained on SYS-G6 from historian replicas; scored on a server in the central OT DMZ (SYS-T3)
data_categories: SCADA historian data (pressures, flows, temperatures, valve states); no personal information
affects_individuals: No (indirectly: people living and working along 7,400 miles of pipeline)
human_in_the_loop: Advisory only. Controllers treat each alert as a prompt to check SCADA and dispatch field staff; the model cannot write to SCADA or change alarms
applicable_laws: 49 CFR 192.631(c), (e)(5), (f), (h); 192.615(a)(12) if used to evaluate a notification of potential rupture; TSA SD 02G III.C and III.E (scoring server is inside a Critical Cyber System); C-ENERGY-R04
status: In production (advisory) since 2026-03; moved to a separate advisory screen 2026-09-08 pending validation; conditions in P10 section 6

use_case: ILI anomaly classification model: classifies metal loss, dent, and crack-like features in in-line inspection data and proposes a remediation category
vendor_or_model: In-house convolutional model trained on ILI data and field-verified dig results (SYS-E2)
data_categories: ILI tool data; dig verification records; client pipeline attributes (client Confidential data)
human_in_the_loop: A Level 3 analyst reviews every feature the model classifies at or near the immediate repair threshold before release; engineers sign every deliverable
applicable_laws: Client contracts; FTC Act Section 5 (claims about the service); clients' duties under 49 CFR 192.933(b) and (d)(1) depend on the classifications
status: In production in client deliverables since 2025-11; undisclosed and not validated (gap 9); conditions in section 6 (POAM-023)

use_case: Compressor predictive maintenance: predicts compressor unit failures from vibration and performance data
business_owner: Vice President of Gas Control (with the Vice President of Field Operations Technology for gathering compressors)
vendor_or_model: Compressor OEM analytics service (vendor model) fed from historian replicas
data_categories: Compressor performance and vibration data; no personal information
human_in_the_loop: Maintenance planners decide work orders; no control actions
applicable_laws: Vendor contract (no write-back; data-use terms); TSA SD 02G III.B (data leaves the OT DMZ one way only)

use_case: Production forecasting: forecasts well and field volumes for marketing and nominations
Automated compressor and choke setpoint optimization: would write setpoints to field controllers to maximize throughput
business_owner: Vice President of Field Operations Technology
affects_individuals: No (indirectly: field crews and neighbors of facilities)
human_in_the_loop: Proposed closed loop with operator override; not acceptable as designed
applicable_laws: Group AI Standard; safety management of change; N21-BM (CSF 2.0 ID.RA-07; PR.PS-01); 192.615 emergency plans for Type C lines (192.9(e)(1)(iv)) if a setpoint error could cause an emergency
status: Not approved; any write-back to OT requires council approval, a safety management of change, and an architecture review (P01 GP-009, Avoid)

use_case: Aerial methane detection: analyzes aircraft sensor imagery to find methane plumes along gathering lines and at facilities
data_categories: Aerial imagery and plume detections with locations
human_in_the_loop: Field crews verify every detection before any repair or report decision
applicable_laws: Vendor contract; does not replace leakage surveys required for Type B and Type C lines (192.9(d)(8), (e)(1)(vii)); environmental reporting rules not analyzed in this sample

use_case: SOC triage assistant: summarizes alerts and suggests next steps for SOC analysts
vendor_or_model: Generative assistant built into the SIEM platform (vendor model, no training on customer data)
data_categories: Security alerts and logs, which may include OT details and SSI
human_in_the_loop: Analysts decide every escalation and containment action; reporting clocks are owned by people (POL-03 4.6)
applicable_laws: POL-04 4.10 (no SSI or OT configurations in generative AI unless approved for that class); vendor terms; SD 01G II.C (a missed escalation could delay a required report)
status: Approved with conditions: SSI-tagged alerts excluded from the assistant until the vendor tenant is approved for Restricted data

use_case: Integrity report drafting assistant: drafts sections of integrity and ILI reports from engineer notes
vendor_or_model: Enterprise generative AI service (no training on group data)
data_categories: Engineer notes; client project data (Confidential); never SSI
human_in_the_loop: Engineers rewrite and sign every report; qualified review before release (POL-05 4.9)
applicable_laws: Client contracts; FTC Act Section 5; POL-04 4.10
status: Pilot with 40 engineers; disclosure to clients required before wider use (P01 ES-012)

use_case: Enterprise generative AI assistant for the workforce (drafting and summarizing internal documents)
vendor_or_model: Enterprise AI assistant under an agreement with no training on group data
data_categories: Internal documents; no SSI, OT configurations, or royalty owner data
human_in_the_loop: Users review outputs; prohibited for employment decisions and for operational or safety decisions
applicable_laws: POL-05 4.9; POL-04 4.10; Texas TRAIGA (intent-based prohibitions; none apply to this use); Colorado SB26-189 not triggered (no consequential decisions)
